scope: Spot trade page and the USD-M futures page. Earn, P2P, Square, NFT, and margin order entry were not exercised. Futures user-data listen keys were not requested.

auth.public_market: tier 0. api.binance.com and stream.binance.com answer a stdlib/curl client with no key.
auth.www_binance_html: tier 8 AWS WAF JS challenge. The trade page's market socket does not use this host.
auth.web_order: tier 7 session. Header csrftoken from cookie cr00, header clienttype=web, session cookie. Anonymous POST is HTTP 401 code 100001005.

websocket.role: spot market data. This is the socket the trade page opens.
websocket.protocol: text JSON. {method:SUBSCRIBE, params:[stream], id}. Binary frames are rejected.

websocket.role: desktop user-data stream when logged in: method userDataStream.subscribe.listenToken. Not used by the page to place orders. ping works without a key.
websocket.live: ping proven; listenToken path requires a logged-in session and was not executed

websocket.role: auxiliary binary socket opened by the loaded page. Not present as a string in the spot bundles that were indexed. Not an order channel. Frames were ArrayBuffer; protocol not decoded.
websocket.live: handshake observed in the page, payload not decoded

websocket.role: official SBE market data, depth diff 20ms. Not referenced by the spot web bundle. Not what the page connects to.
websocket.live: not used by the web client
